title: Helpful tips for traveling with Alaska and Hawaiian this holiday season
summary: Alaska Airlines will operate more than 16,600 flights and welcome nearly 1.7 million guests during the Thanksgiving travel period, with Nov. 29 expected to be the busiest travel day.
body_markdown:
This November alone, Alaska and Hawaiian expect to serve guests approximately 220,000 preordered meals.


Traveling on a flight over 775 miles? Guests can preorder meals on most eligible flights starting two weeks before departure and up to 18 hours before takeoff via alaskaair.com, hawaiianairlines.com or the Alaska Hawaiian app.[Meal options vary by flight distance and whether traveling on Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines.](https://www.alaskaair.com/content/travel-info/flight-experience/main-cabin/food-and-drink?srsltid=AYCX9vKXuQeJYs_ZbzzZJi9iQpwxQWOG496pHxn2jSjH9fh0rX6tvXIA)


Need some help choosing a meal?[Chef Sheldon Simeon’s](https://news.alaskaair.com/guest-experience/hawaiian-airlines-elevates-onboard-service/) crispy mochiko chicken and garlic noodles is the most popular menu item among Hawaiian Airlines guests, while Alaska Airlines’ iconic fruit and cheese platter remains a year-round favorite and its most preordered item.


This November alone, Alaska and Hawaiian expect to serve approximately 220,000 preordered meals to guests.
